deployments_detail.use: Clinical AI suite: risk-scoring models to reduce hospitalisations, AI decision support in critical care, predictive personalised treatment (12 AI apps); Roche & Microsoft partnerships

Clinical Intelligence Engine (CIE): AI-powered clinical decision support / symptom-checker built on Google Cloud Vertex AI and later augmented with MedLM and RAG; helps doctors analyze symptoms, determine causes and recommend care. Rolled out across India and via Apollo 24|7. [Google Cloud (Vertex AI, MedLM, generative AI, RAG)]
deployments_detail.value: More than 4,000 Apollo doctors using it

deployments_detail.use: AI-powered continuous vital-signs / patient monitoring system: sensor sheets under beds stream data to the EMR, AI detects abnormal heart/respiration patterns and alerts nurses for early intervention (reducing cardiac Code Blue events). [none]
deployments_detail.value: 80% reduction in Code Blues in 9 months; nurse vitals-recording time cut from 3.5h to 1h (70%); ward ops cost -26%

deployments_detail.use: AI-powered brain-scan analysis for acute stroke: AI system flags possible stroke on CT/imaging to radiologists within minutes across a network of stroke labs in Chennai, accelerating diagnosis-to-treatment. [none]
deployments_detail.value: Scan-to-interpretation time cut to ~7 minutes from ~30 minutes; 9 advanced stroke labs across Chennai

deployments_detail.use: AI-powered stroke management platform (partnership with Medtronic): FDA-approved AI generates advanced images from non-contrast CT, CTA, CT perfusion and MRI to automate stroke analysis and speed treatment decisions. [Medtronic (India Medtronic)]
deployments_detail.value: Reduces diagnosis time from ~60 minutes to under 2 minutes

deployments_detail.use: AICVD: AI-based cardiovascular disease risk score API (developed with Microsoft AI Network for Healthcare) predicting 10-year CVD event risk from Indian patient data; available to doctors across the Apollo network and published on Azure Marketplace. [Microsoft (Azure)]
Apollo Radiology International using Google AI screening models for early detection of TB, lung cancer and breast cancer to expand access to free screenings. [Google (Google Health AI)]
deployments_detail.value: 3 million free screenings for TB, lung and breast cancer

deployments_detail.use: India's first 5G/AI-driven colonoscopy: AI-assisted colonoscopy polyp detection trial over Airtel 5G, using cloud AI to improve accuracy and speed of colon cancer detection. [Bharti Airtel (5G), AWS]

Four generative-AI sales/marketing use cases on Salesforce CRM (built with Wohlig): conversational analytics over CRM data (Gemini Enterprise), a five-agent Vertex AI geospatial field-rep optimizer, doctor-network mining agents, and a content-generation agent (newsletters/brochures/images/video) distributed via Salesforce email + WhatsApp. [Google Gemini / Vertex AI, Salesforce, Wohlig Transformations]

Automation of clinical documentation audits: Azure OpenAI Service identifies discrepancies in EMRs and ensures documentation quality/consistency, replacing a largely manual audit process across the hospital network. [Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service]
deployments_detail.value: Deployed across 72 hospitals; previously required 50 dedicated auditors; near real-time vs weeks

deployments_detail.use: Enterprise data unification on Microsoft Fabric (OneLake medallion architecture, Real-Time Intelligence 'Operational Cockpit' for bed availability/alerts) as the AI-ready foundation, with a Clinical Copilot for instant patient history in design. [Microsoft Fabric (Copilot in Fabric planned)]
deployments_detail.value: Across 75 hospitals; 25% reduction in manual work; data latency 4h to 2s; 230TB consolidated to 30TB

deployments_detail.use: Adoption of four AI healthcare copilots (for clinicians, patients, nurses and hospital operations) as part of a Microsoft collaboration to embed AI into clinical and operational workflows. [Microsoft]
